subject: INLA stopped working after upgrade (library problem)

messages.author: 928a129fe0016f39
messages.subject: INLA stopped working after upgrade (library problem)
parts:
Dear All,

I upgraded the INLA dev version to the latest. However, it stopped working when I try to build a mesh and I get this error:

/***/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/fmesher: relocation error: /***/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/fmesher: symbol _ZTTNSt7__cxx1118basic_stringstreamIcSt11char_traitsIcESaIcEEE, version GLIBCXX_3.4.21 not defined in file libstdc++.so.6 with link time reference
Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") :
  File '/***/tmp/RtmpN8R3Ry/fmesher3b337cf958ff.manifold' does not exist.

Previous version worked fine. From some googling it appears that the problem is that I have wrong version of some C++ library, but installing other version with all dependencies seems to be overly complicated. I also downloaded the INLA sources and tried to compile it by myself if that would help, but the compilation fails to some missing C files. What can I do?

Thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA stopped working after upgrade (library problem)
parts:
On Sun, 2016-10-16 at 01:23 -0700, Jussi wrote:
> Dear All,
>
> I upgraded the INLA dev version to the latest. However, it stopped
> working when I try to build a mesh and I get this error:
>
> /***/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/fmesher: relocation error:
> /***/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/fmesher: symbol
> _ZTTNSt7__cxx1118basic_stringstreamIcSt11char_traitsIcESaIcEEE,
> version GLIBCXX_3.4.21 not defined in file libstdc++.so.6 with link
> time reference
> Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") :
>   File '/***/tmp/RtmpN8R3Ry/fmesher3b337cf958ff.manifold' does not
> exist.
>

you run probably on an to old linux system. you can try the workaround

INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()


and then continue.  it just set the path to the static build which is
without R-support (see inla.doc("rgeneric"))
--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
